title: Seed Sampler handoff notes — weekly sync
body:
Purpose
Quick handoff / sync log for the 'seed sampler' workstream — small lightweight notes for night shift and anyone joining the thread. Focus: how we seed the KV cache for cold cohorts, edge cases for batching while seeding, and kernel-level safety checks. Not a formal RFC; this is actionable operational + design status.

Attendees
- Aisha (owner)
- Marco (kernel lead)
- Priya (ops/observability)
- Ethan (night-ops rotation)
- Optional: Jim and Sara dropped in for QA context

High-level summary
- Experiment v2 of the sampler (seed-first strategy) ran for 48h against cohort gamma on us-west-2. Observed: 17% drop in 95th percentile tail for seeded queries when sampler completed within 120ms.
- Risk: sampler can contend with short-lived high-priority micro-batches (p99 concurrency spikes). Need to ensure sampler acquires soft tokens with eviction-friendly flags.
- Kernel change required: expose non-blocking prefill syscall for lightweight prefills; Marco has draft patch.

Recent changes applied this week
1) Sampler backpressure window reduced from 300ms -> 120ms (config: sampler.window_ms).
2) New metric: sampler.prefill_duration_ms (emit to infra metrics). Priya wired dashboards.
3) Kernel interface: prefill_async() returns a reservation token; caller can opt-in to low-priority scheduling (PR #4382).

Observations / anomalies
- On 2027-04-06 03:12 UTC we saw a cascading eviction on an 8-GPU Dedicated pool when sampler concurrency hit 18. Eviction log: multiple small keys evicted then thrash. Hypothesis: cache bloom sizing + sampler burst.
- Some requests in the cohort were seeing prefix-miss + sampler-trigger -> immediate micro-batch dispatch; this increases tiny-batch inefficiency (per-token overhead).
- Night-ops report: sampler retries appear as 'ghost' latency in traces; need better tagging so APM can filter sampler background work.

Open questions
- Should sampler prefer warm-hosts when routing? (Marco: technically doable via kernel hint, but changes routing layer).
- What is acceptable upper bound for sampler concurrency for Dedicated customers? (Customer SLAs matter.)
- Do we expose sampler controls to customers (on/off/priority) or keep internal? Ops prefers a kill-switch per-deployment.

Action items (owner -> due)
- Marco: post kernel patch iteration with bench numbers and residency profile (due 2027-04-10).
- Priya: update grafana to add sampler-prefill breakdown and generate alert for prefill_duration_ms > 250ms (due 2027-04-09).
- Ethan: create runbook snippet for night-ops to safely pause sampler (include steps to drain inflight reservations) (due 2027-04-11).
- Aisha: write short proposal on customer toggles (feature vs internal op flag) and attach to INF-2217 (due 2027-04-12).

Micro debugging notes (scratchpad)
- Log snippets: "sampler:reservation=0x1a2b low-prio=true duration=89ms"
- Kernel counters to watch: prefill_attempts, prefill_failures, prefill_reservations, sampler_blocked_by_kernel
- Quick CLI to inspect reservations (helpful for oncall): infractl cache reservations --pool=<pool> --since=10m

Patch / experiment trackers
- PR #4382: prefill_async kernel API (Marco) — review requested.
- Experiment run id: exp-seed-v2-20270406 (internal artifact) — cohort gamma only.
- Perf benchmark: seed-v2-run-48h => p95 reduced by 17%, cost delta +3% token-equivalent due to prefill work.

Night-ops checklist (short)
- If eviction spiral detected: 1) pause sampler; 2) increase bloom sizing for cohort gamma; 3) let caches stabilize 5m; 4) re-enable sampler at half concurrency.
- When pausing sampler use infractl feature-flag set sampler.enabled=false --scope=<deployment>.

Notes to self / things to document later
- Long-term: consider sampler-aware batching: sampler-proxy that coordinates with batcher to piggyback prefill onto existing micro-batches. That reduces extra tokens.
- Consider TTL tagging per-seed so eviction logic can prefer evicting seeds with low hit-rate.

References & quick links
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/4382
- INF ticket: JIRA-INF-2217 (Sampler feature toggle + runbook)
- Confluence: seed-sampler-design-v2 (sketches and proto traces)

Closing
We want this handoff doc to be the lightweight weekly anchor while the kernel patch stabilizes. If you're on night rotation please subscribe to the grafana alert and add any anomalous trace ids to the INF-2217 ticket.

-- Aisha
